description:
Look up a transaction on Base or Ethereum by hash: did it succeed, when, who sent it to whom, the ETH value and fee, and every ERC-20 transfer it made with token symbols and amounts. Use it to confirm a payment actually landed.

$0.003 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: transaction_lookup
title: Transaction lookup
